name: young-cohorts-only
about: §4R L2: a young account — every cohort is younger than 28 days, so the sheet holds counts and no rates at all.

output.headline: Regional Class A — Joliet was the only campaign running November 3, 2026, spending $75.00 for 3 leads at $25.00 each.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet delivered 3,900 impressions, 48 clicks, and 3 leads on a $75.00 spend, with a click rate of 1.2% and a cost per lead of $25.00.
Month to date in November 2026, Meta spend stands at $225.00 with 28 days left in the month.
The 2026-10-19 cohort (9 leads) has 8 contacted, 4 converted, 2 applied, and 1 hired, with none closed before or after conversion — still too young to judge by rates.
The 2026-10-26 cohort (14 leads) has 10 contacted, 3 converted, 1 applied, and 2 lost after conversion, with no hires yet — also too young to judge by rates.
No lead quality data is available for the 14-day window; the campaigns list is empty, so there is nothing to report on wrong numbers or missed hard requirements.
